text:
Maya Rao: Quick heads up — prepping the exec review for Crestline next week. Need two quick things: 1) final health + renewal risk snapshot on slide 3, 2) who owns the live demo (short feature walkthrough). Dropping the draft deck here: https://redwood-cloud.s3/crestsync/deck-v1.pptx  

Jon Peters: I can take the demo if Priya is tied up. 11:30am PT works for a 20m dry run tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Priya Nair: I want to cover enablement gaps (onboarding -> product adoption) — happy to co-run the demo with Jon. Can Alex pull the latest perf numbers for the adoption slide?

Alex Kim: Yep — will pull 30-day latency and error-rate slices from telemetry. Will add a simple chart to the perf slide. Need the sequence length and qps target you expect for the demo.

Maya Rao: Adding numbers: demo target = 20 concurrent sessions, seq len ~ 512 avg. Renewal risk = "Amber" (renewal signal down from 0.8 -> 0.6 last 90d). Putting a small heatmap on slide 3 and a short renewal ask: exec intro + pricing options.

onboarding-bot: New onboarding survey ingested (2026-03-20): NPS 7.4, top request: more interactive onboarding templates. Filed as ticket CS-1129.

Jon Peters: Copying recent onboarding feedback for slide notes — low friction for SSO + better handoff docs. I'll paste directly into the notes: 
- Need SSO walkthrough with screenshots
- Request for example prompts + guardrails
- Clarify dedicated vs hosted capacity benefits

Priya Nair: I'll synthesize that into a 2-slide enablement plan (owners + timeline). Quick ask: who can own the SSO walkthrough writeup? @Alex Kim?

Alex Kim: I can own the SSO writeup. ETA: EOD Friday. Will also attach the perf CSV to the deck.

Maya Rao: Thanks — putting together the dry-run plan: 11:30am PT tomorrow in #customer-success huddle. Slide owners: Maya (exec summary + renewal ask), Alex (perf + SSO writeup pointer), Priya (enablement plan + adoption milestones), Jon (commercial ask + feedback capture). I'll circulate the meeting invite and a link to the slide timestamp we should rehearse.

Jon Peters: I'll prepare the renewal options slide (3 options: 6mo pilot, 12mo committed, enterprise bundle) and a topline ask for exec. Also will DM the AE lead to request a short intro at the meeting.

Priya Nair: Added follow-up checklist into the deck notes and created GH issue CS-4521 to track post-review actions. I'll put owners on each line.

Maya Rao: Final action list for the thread (quick):
- Alex: SSO walkthrough doc + perf chart (EOD Fri)
- Priya: Enablement 2-slide plan + assign owners (before dry-run)
- Jon: Renewal options slide + request exec intro (before dry-run)
- Maya: Finalize heatmap + update risk bullets (before dry-run)

Maya Rao: Thanks all — drop any blockers here. If no objections I'll lock the deck 2 hours before the dry-run. :lock:
